systems.country_label: identité numérique unifiée, fiable, performante, inclusive et souveraine
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Intérieur et de la Décentralisation, with World Bank support through PATN
systems.tiers: national, foundations being laid at the workshop of 16 to 18 July 2025

note: The Interior ministry's director general of territorial administration, opening the digital identity workshop on 16 July 2025, called the ministry the guarantor of identification and civil status and said many citizens hold no valid identity document. No civil registration system is named.
